Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.ui

Class ResultTableModel

java.lang.Object
javax.swing.table.AbstractTableModel
org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.ui.ResultTableModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, TableModel
public final class ResultTableModel extends AbstractTableModel
A read-only TableModel that pages over the rows of a QueryResult held in memory. Only one page (at most pageSize rows) is exposed to the JTable at a time, so a result capped at the configured maximum renders quickly and the user pages through it with the grid's First/Prev/Next/Last controls.

SQL NULLs are rendered as the configured null text. Editing happens through the SQL editor (which produces the DML), not in-place, so every cell is non-editable here.
